rationale: Class 1 source confirmation shows that the negative costs are printed by the filing, not introduced by extraction. The ABC Legal revolver source row reports cost (15) and fair value (12) in thousands, exactly matching stored cost -15000 and fair value -12000. A second flagged pattern instance, ATL II MRO, likewise reports cost (75) and fair value (64). C107 is therefore an overbroad monitoring heuristic for legitimate parenthesized negative revolver values, so the flag is a false alarm rather than a data error.
